title: streaming_stores for MEM_BW_BOUND
rationale_md:
The output buffer is never read again, but the default store allocates the line in L2
first (write-allocate). `st.global.cs` (via `__stcs`) marks the line as streaming so it
is evicted early, removing the extra read-modify-write traffic that the profiler shows
as excess DRAM bytes.
refs: PTX ISA: cache operators on st
expected_effect: avoid L2 write-allocate traffic on a streaming output

title: reduce_smem for LOW_OCCUPANCY
rationale_md:
Shared memory per block caps resident CTAs. Narrowing the stage buffers (or dropping the
staging ring) raises the CTA count per SM.
